name: aegis-integrity
description: Check papers for copied text, AI-written passages, fabricated citations and publisher-style problems, on your own computer.
long_description: AEGIS is an open-source academic integrity checker. It finds copied and paraphrased text against your own comparison library, scores AI-like writing with calibration for non-native English writers, verifies every reference against Crossref, and checks equations, grammar and IEEE/ACM/Elsevier/IET/BCS/ISACA style rules. Documents are analysed locally; only reference metadata is sent to Crossref. Requires the AEGIS Python package: pip install "aegis-integrity[mcp,ml] @ git+https://github.com/sunilgentyala/aegis-integrity".

python.title: Python with AEGIS installed
